additional_info.subject: ID0393033-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R1 170001401] Device went offline after v4.0.11 fw downgrade CRM:00797001509
additional_info.body:
Dear Yunus,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Sominath
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R1 170001401
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
vQvYOL
Problem Description
: Device went offline after v4.0.11 fw downgrade
Troubleshooting
:
It seems that you attempted to downgrade from SCB in the same way as a regular upgrade. However, downgrading from 5.x.x to v4.0.11 can only be performed by R&D or L3 via SSH.
At this point, we need to check the charger onsite to determine if it is operational. If the issue is related to the connection of Router1, we will need to address and rectify the Router1 issue to resolve it.
If the charger has crashed or is boot looping after the downgrade, you can perform the downgrade onsite by flashing the CFast card with FW 4.0.11 and using the Live Linux USB to restore the configuration.
We will share the configuration for the Live Linux USB shortly to assist with this restoration.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0393033
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sominath Nagalgaon
